title: entitySummaryFacts
responsibility: Builds the performance profile definition rows without changing workload context.

inputs.name: measurementLocation.row
inputs.description: The performance observation whose target and profile are the only fields read to build the location. An empty target or profile is left out of the location, and when both are empty the result is the em dash ('—').

examples.note: Nothing was measured for this run.

inputs.name: entitySummaryFacts.measure
inputs.description: Size rows keep their original order, and rows whose target is 'none' are skipped. Performance rows are only searched: the primary row is the first whose metric contains latency, navigation, duration, or time (or starts with p and a digit) and whose value is not 'Not measured', and the memory row is the first whose metric contains memory, heap, or rss and, when a primary row exists, shares its workload, target, and profile.

size.label: Source map
size.note: The build did not emit a source map.

inputs.name: entitySummaryFacts.compact
inputs.description: When true, the result ends with Latency and Memory facts from the matched rows, and the note field of a size row is set only when its value is unmeasured. When false, the result ends with detailed workload facts only if exactly one performance row exists; with no performance rows it ends with unmeasured Latency and Memory facts, and with two or more it adds no performance facts.

outputs.name: measurementLocation
outputs.description: The target and profile joined with ' · ' when both are non-empty, or whichever one is non-empty when only one is. The em dash ('—') is returned when neither is non-empty.

outputs.name: entitySummaryFacts
outputs.description: Size rows whose target is not 'none' come first, followed by Latency and Memory facts when compact is true or there are no performance rows, or by Workload, Environment, metric, and Tolerance facts when compact is false and exactly one performance row exists; with compact false and two or more performance rows, nothing follows the size rows. Unmeasured size rows and facts are kept with the 'unmeasured' className rather than removed.

errors.description: An error thrown by a getter on a supplied object propagates out of the function unchanged, because the function reads properties directly. The function does not catch, wrap, clone, or serialize the input, so the caller receives the getter's own error.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when the row argument, measure, measure.size, or measure.performance is null or undefined, or when a size or performance entry the function reads is null or undefined, because the function reads their properties without a guard. The function does not check for these values, so the TypeError is not caught or converted.
